## What You’ll See

The tour starts in La Candelaria, Bogotá’s historic centre. You’ll visit the Gold Museum, the Casa de la Moneda and the Fernando Botero collection, walk across Bolívar Square and go up Monserrate. A separate day takes you outside the capital to Lake Guatavita, associated with the legend of El Dorado, and Zipaquirá, with its famous Salt Cathedral.

The Coffee Region shows a very different side of Colombia. At El Ocaso farm, you’ll follow the coffee bean from planting and hand-picking through drying, processing and roasting. Then head to the Cocora Valley to see the wax palms and to Salento for its colonial streets and artisans’ workshops.

In Medellín, the programme combines art museums, the city’s history and a visit to Comuna 13. The next day takes you to Guatapé and the enormous El Peñón de Guatapé, which rises above low green hills.

In Cartagena, you’ll find fortified walls, San Felipe de Barajas, La Popa, the historic centre and a Caribbean breeze. After the city tour, the trip continues by speedboat to the Rosario Islands, home to coral reefs and a national underwater park.
